quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results deck: AI DC revenue KRW 131.4bn vs KRW 69.4bn in Q1 2025 (+89.3% YoY), attributed to higher utilization of new DCs and revenue contribution from GPUaaS; AI B2B/B2C revenue KRW 45.0bn (down 10.3% YoY) on lower Cloud business revenue. Consolidated revenue KRW 4,392.3bn (down 1.4% YoY) and operating income KRW 537.6bn (down 5.3%); SKB revenue KRW 1,149.8bn (+3.2%) thanks to DC business growth; CapEx KRW 136.5bn. The company describes itself as the only company in Korea with AI full-stack capabilities, including what it calls Korea's largest AI DC.
quarterly_data.figure: AI DC rev KRW 131.4bn (+89.3% YoY); AI B2B/B2C KRW 45.0bn; Q1 CapEx KRW 136.5bn
